text: The failsafe engages and the pump keeps running.
The pipeline never exceeds its p99 latency budget.
The caught exception is logged with its stack trace.
The build fails over to the mirror registry when the primary is slow.
A failing test's output is shown inline.
Neither dark nor light theme is forced; the system preference is honoured.
The commit is created without a signature when gpg is unavailable.
The sidebar shows nothing until the first project is created.
Duplicate submissions are deduplicated; only the first is stored.
Invalid-looking but well-formed addresses are accepted.
A cache miss falls through to the origin.
